Why ProtoMed

Built for the Way Your Specialty Bills

Medical billing is not one-size-fits-all. Cardiology codes differently than behavioral health. Orthopedics has different modifier rules than radiology. ProtoMed's certified billing team is trained in the nuances of your specialty — delivering faster payments, cleaner claims, and fewer headaches.

  • 01

    Specialty-Specific Coding Experts

    Every specialty has its own CPT codes, modifiers, and payer rules. Our certified coders specialize in your field so claims are submitted correctly the first time, every time.

  • 02

    98%+ Clean Claim Rate

    Fewer denials means faster payments. Our pre-submission review catches errors before they reach the payer, keeping your revenue cycle running at peak performance.

  • 03

    AAPC & AHIMA Certified Coders

    Your practice is coded by certified professionals who hold active credentials in medical billing and coding — minimizing audit risk and maximizing reimbursement accuracy.

  • 04

    100% HIPAA Compliant

    We follow strict HIPAA safeguards at every stage of the billing process. Your patient data stays protected, and your practice stays fully compliant.

  • 05

    Ready for Your Current EHR

    We work directly inside your existing systems — Epic, Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, AdvancedMD, and more — with zero disruption to your daily workflow.

  • 06

    No Contracts. No Hidden Fees.

    Transparent pricing, no lock-in agreements. You stay because the results speak for themselves — not because you're obligated to.

Ready to Simplify Billing for Your Specialty?

Select your specialty above or speak directly with a ProtoMed billing expert. We'll review your current billing process, identify revenue gaps, and show you exactly what your practice is leaving on the table — at no cost.
